extraction: Raw VizieR asu-tsv response saved verbatim. Rows counted after skipping '#' comment lines, the header line, the units line and the '---' separator line; blank trailing lines excluded.
note: Treu et al. 2015 ApJ 812, 114, Table 3: the GLASS (HST/WFC3 Grism Lens-Amplified Survey from Space) redshift catalogue for MACS J0717.5+3745 (247 entries). MEASURED: RA/Dec (J2000), GLASS grism/spectroscopic redshift z, redshift quality q_z (0-4), multiple-solution flag f_z. This is a SMALL catalogue and is the weakest link of the seven clusters. NO membership column, no magnitudes in the VizieR table, no stellar mass, no Sersic parameters.
